subject: English
questionText:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate adverb.

He responded ________ to the allegations, without admitting fault.
solution:
Meaning: To respond evasively means in a way that avoids giving a direct answer or taking a firm position, perfectly matching "without admitting fault".

The other adverbs do not fit the context of dodging responsibility or blame.
conceptTested: Contextual vocabulary and appropriate adverb usage

subject: English
questionText:
Choose the option that best represents the direct narration of the given sentence.

She said that she had three sisters and one brother.

options.A: She said, "I have three sisters and one brother."
options.B: She said, "She have had three sisters and one brother."
options.C: She said, "I had three sisters and one brother."
options.D: She said, "I have three sisters and a brother."
options.a: She said, "I have three sisters and one brother."
options.b: She said, "She have had three sisters and one brother."
options.c: She said, "I had three sisters and one brother."
options.d: She said, "I have three sisters and a brother."

solution:
Rules: In changing indirect to direct speech: • The past tense auxiliary/verb had in the indirect clause reverts to simple present have for a habitual/factual state.
• The third - person pronoun she changes back to first - person I.
• The exact original wording retains one brother, making option (A) the accurate direct speech.
conceptTested: Conversion of indirect speech back to direct speech involving tense shift and pronoun change

subject: English
questionText:
Choose the appropriate direct speech equivalent of the following sentence.

The laborers said that they wouldn't have enough time to complete the assigned work.

options.A: The laborers said, "They won't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.B: The laborers said, "We wouldn't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.C: The laborers said, "We don't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.D: The laborers said, "We won't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.a: The laborers said, "They won't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.b: The laborers said, "We wouldn't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.c: The laborers said, "We don't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
options.d: The laborers said, "We won't have enough time to complete the assigned work."

solution:
Rules: • The third - person pronoun they referring to the speakers becomes first - person plural we.
• The modal wouldn't in indirect narration corresponds to won't (will not) in direct speech.
• Therefore, the direct speech is: The laborers said, "We won't have enough time to complete the assigned work."
conceptTested: Conversion of indirect narration modals and pronouns to direct speech equivalents

subject: English
questionText: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Courteous".
solution:
Meaning: Courteous means polite, respectful, or considerate in manner.

The direct antonym is insolent, which means showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect.

Other options: • Arrogant: having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance.
• Ashamed: embarrassed or guilty because of one's actions.
• Ignorant: lacking knowledge or awareness.
Vocab Meanings: • Courteous: Polite and respectful
• Insolent: Rude and disrespectful
• Arrogant: Thinking too highly of oneself
• Ashamed: Feeling shame
• Ignorant: Lacking knowledge
conceptTested: Knowledge of direct antonyms and vocabulary building
